title: Weak mixing of every triangular billiard with an irrational angle
exact_target: For every Euclidean triangle having at least one angle whose ratio to pi is irrational, is its billiard flow weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure, after deleting trajectories that hit a vertex?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For every Euclidean triangle having at least one angle whose ratio to pi is irrational, is its billiard flow weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure, after deleting trajectories that hit a vertex?

\subsection{Short English statement}
For every Euclidean triangle having at least one angle whose ratio to pi is irrational, is its billiard flow weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure, after deleting trajectories that hit a vertex?
